title: Overdrive API error
description: The body of every non-2xx answer of the service's /v1 API (spec §8.3, ADR 0014). The HTTP status says what class of failure it is; the code is stable and meant for programs, the message is for people and may change. Statuses: 400 invalid_json, invalid_ride_id, invalid_range; 401 unauthorized; 404 ride_not_found, not_found; 409 ride_conflict, start_time_conflict, fit_conflict; 413 payload_too_large; 415 unsupported_media_type; 422 invalid_record, invalid_profile, ride_id_mismatch, invalid_fit; 500 internal_error.
